quote: Of the 6,169 shared variants (Figure 1A), 88.3% of interpretations between laboratories were concordant, with 62.3% (3,845 variants) in exact agreement and 26.0% (1,600 variants) differing only in confidence levels (P vs. LP and LB vs. B).

further_quotes.quote: 6,169 variants in ClinVar were interpreted by at least two of the participating laboratories, of which 88.3% were initially concordant.
Participating laboratories increased their overall concordance from 88.3% to 91.7%
Comparison of data in ClinVar identified 6,169 variants from 308 genes interpreted by at least two of the four participating laboratories.
The remaining 11.7% (724) of shared variants had discordant interpretations
3.5% (216 variants) of all shared variants were medically significant differences (MSDs), pathogenic (P/LP) versus other (VUS/LB/B)
and only 12 variants of this set (5.6%) had P/LP versus LB/B differences.
The remaining 8.2% (508 variants) of all shared variants were VUS versus benign (LB/B) differences

observations: Konkordant heißt bei Harrison et al. einschließlich reiner Konfidenzunterschiede (P gegen LP, LB gegen B); exakte Übereinstimmung der fünf Klassen sind 62,3 %. Diskordant 11,7 % = medizinisch bedeutsam 3,5 % (P/LP gegen VUS/LB/B) + VUS gegen LB/B 8,2 %; das entspricht der ClinVar-Konfliktdefinition (Gruppen P/LP, VUS, LB/B). Die Neubewertung betraf 242 der 724 diskordanten Varianten. Der Wert 12 (P/LP gegen LB/B) ist der Vergleichswert für gefährliche Fehler in ANK-58 (docs/03 A.1).
